provision_name: Section 302 in The Indian Penal Code, 1860
text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

provision_name: Section 307 in The Indian Penal Code, 1860
text: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of murder, shall be punished (attempt to murder).

provision_name: Section 498A in The Indian Penal Code, 1860
text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished.

provision_name: Section 304B in The Indian Penal Code, 1860
text: Where the death of a woman is caused within seven years of her marriage and she was subjected to cruelty for dowry, such death shall be called dowry death.

provision_name: Section 506 in The Indian Penal Code, 1860
text: Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation shall be punished.

provision_name: Section 34 in The Indian Penal Code, 1860
text: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each is liable.

provision_name: Section 438 in The Code Of Criminal Procedure, 1973
text: Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest (anticipatory bail).
No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
